{{Quote|A Jedi seeks to improve himself through study.|Vikto|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Vikto''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A fair-skinned man with [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and a<ref name="TOR" /> ritual<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Zabrak}}</ref> facial [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]], Vikto wore brown [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] over [[Armor/Legends|armor]], and spent much of his [[Time/Legends|time]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="TOR" /> Vikto also accompanied Republic forces to [[Keylander Station]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]]<ref name="ROTHC">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref> in [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Year">{{TOR updates|2.0}}</ref> and to the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] facility [[CZ-198]] during the [[Seizure of CZ-198|seizure]] of the facility<ref name="TOR" /> later that year<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|2.3}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Vikto first appeared as a PvP gear vendor for Jedi Knights in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" /> However, with the reorganization of the gear system that accompanied Game Update 2.0 and the release of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'']] Digital Expansion, Vikto was changed to a Basic Gear Vendor who could found on Carrick Station, Keylander Station, and CZ-198.<ref name="ROTHC" /> Vikto was later removed in Game Update 5.0 on [[November 29]], [[2016]], which retired the PvP and PvE gear vendors in favor of the Command system.<ref name="5.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/11292016/game-update-5.0-knights-eternal-throne-early-access|text=Game Update 5.0: Knights of the Eternal Throne Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
